description: Every word a specification may use. Generated from the executor; a word is admitted only once something real answers it.

matchers.description: Rows present at an endpoint, read from the endpoint itself rather than from the product's record of what it wrote.

How many changes the pipeline's nests could never place in a document, added up over its namespaces and read from the metrics face. Nothing else says it: these rows were never going to appear in any document, so a pipeline discarding all of them and one discarding none have the same counts, state and code.
The pipeline's published error count, read from the metrics face: one while it is FAILED, zero otherwise.
The canonical code of the failure the pipeline published, read from the status face: what killed the run, not just that it died.
The pipeline's published lifecycle state, read from the observation face.
